title: The Midnight Squeaky Floorboard Polish
crime_description: The floor of the silent monastery was coated in high-gloss silicone buff, turning it into a treacherous ice rink.

suspect.name: Bartholomew Wimplebottom III
suspect.quirk: Speaks in over-the-top, hyperbolic comparisons to various cheeses

dossier.text: Security footage shows a figure in a bright orange jumpsuit entering the abbey at 10:10 PM.
The monastery's maintenance log shows no record of silicone buff being ordered or stored on the premises.
Monk eyewitnesses report seeing Bartholomew Wimplebottom III sneaking around the abbey in his Extreme Ironing Competitor uniform at 10:45 PM.

truth_timeline.event: Bartholomew Wimplebottom III prepares tools and sneaks in, comparing his stealth to the 'gouda silence of a Swiss dairy farm'.
Bartholomew Wimplebottom III executes the micro-crime, declaring the newly-coated floor 'as slick as a brie-wrapped wheel of cheddar'.
Bartholomew Wimplebottom III flees, accidentally dropping evidence, much like a 'tangy feta crumbles underfoot'.

lie_plan.cover_story: Bartholomew Wimplebottom III claims to be on a top-secret Extreme Ironing mission to 'soothe the savage beast of wrinkles' in the abbey's ancient tapestries.

weak_points.claim: I was in the abbey's library, researching the 'gouda science of ironing' and didn't even know about the silicone buff.
weak_points.planned_slip: I'm shocked, SHOCKED, to hear that someone was seen entering the abbey in a bright orange jumpsuit.

weak_points.claim: The monastery's maintenance log is clearly a 'feta-stuffed lie' and I have no idea how the silicone buff got there.
weak_points.planned_slip: I'm not aware of any records of silicone buff being ordered or stored on the premises, but that doesn't mean it didn't happen.

weak_points.claim: I was just... um... helping the monks with their 'brie-ific' laundry, and I'm afraid I must have left my Extreme Ironing Competitor uniform behind.
weak_points.planned_slip: I'm not sure what the monks are talking about, but I do know that I was there to help with the laundry... somehow.

solution_contradictions: Suspect claimed he was in the library researching ironing, which directly conflicts with fact-1.
Suspect claimed the maintenance log was a lie, which directly conflicts with fact-2.
